questions.question: A rectangular vegetable garden in Kelowna has a total area of (6x + 9) square metres. One rectangular bed inside it is shaded to show where the tomatoes grow, and that shaded bed has an area of (2x + 3) square metres. Everything else in the garden is unshaded. Which polynomial gives the unshaded area, in square metres?
questions.explain: Unshaded = whole − shaded, so add the opposite of every term of (2x + 3): 6x + 9 − 2x − 3 = 4x + 6. The common trap is taking away the 2x but forgetting to also take away the 3, which gives 4x + 12.

questions.question: A rectangular mural wall at a Nanaimo school has a total area of (8x + 5) square metres. The part already painted is shaded, and that shaded rectangle has an area of (3x − 2) square metres. The unpainted part is unshaded. Which polynomial gives the unshaded area, in square metres?
questions.explain: Subtracting (3x − 2) means adding the opposite of each term, −3x and +2: 8x + 5 − 3x + 2 = 5x + 7. Taking away a negative 2 is the same as adding 2; the trap is treating it as taking away 2 and getting 5x + 3.

questions.question: A rectangular skate park in Burnaby has a total area of (5x² + 2x + 7) square metres. The bowl section is shaded, and that shaded section has an area of (2x² − 3x + 4) square metres. The flat unshaded part is everything else. Which polynomial gives the unshaded area, in square metres?
questions.explain: Add the opposite of every term of (2x² − 3x + 4): 5x² + 2x + 7 − 2x² + 3x − 4 = 3x² + 5x + 3. Subtracting −3x adds 3x; the trap is still taking 3x away, which gives −x instead of +5x.

questions.question: A rectangular gym floor has a total area of (7x² + 4x + 3) square metres. The volleyball court is shaded, and that shaded court has an area of (3x² + x − 6) square metres. The rest of the floor is unshaded. Which polynomial gives the unshaded area, in square metres?
questions.explain: Add the opposite of every term of (3x² + x − 6): 7x² + 4x + 3 − 3x² − x + 6 = 4x² + 3x + 9. The trap is with the last term: subtracting −6 adds 6, so the constant becomes 3 + 6 = 9, not 3 − 6 = −3.

questions.question: Simplify: (4x + 8) − (−9x + 3)
questions.explain: Add the opposite of every term in (−9x + 3), which is +9x and −3: 4x + 8 + 9x − 3 = 13x + 5. Subtracting −9x adds 9x, and the +3 must also change sign to −3 instead of staying as it is.

questions.question: Two drones are flying over a field in Abbotsford. After t seconds the first drone is (3t² + 8t + 20) metres above the ground and the second drone is (t² − 5t + 12) metres above the ground. Which polynomial shows how much higher the first drone is than the second?
questions.explain: How much higher means first height − second height, so add the opposite of every term of (t² − 5t + 12): 3t² + 8t + 20 − t² + 5t − 12 = 2t² + 13t + 8. The trap is treating −5t as if you still take away 5t instead of adding it.

questions.question: What polynomial must be added to (2x² − 5x + 1) to get (7x² − x − 6)?
questions.explain: The missing polynomial is (7x² − x − 6) − (2x² − 5x + 1); add the opposite of each term: 7x² − x − 6 − 2x² + 5x − 1 = 5x² + 4x − 7. The trap is subtracting only the 2x² and then copying −5x + 1 without changing their signs.

questions.question: Subtract (−4x + 7) from (3x − 2).
questions.explain: 'Subtract A from B' means B − A, so this is (3x − 2) − (−4x + 7). Add the opposite of every term, +4x and −7: 3x − 2 + 4x − 7 = 7x − 9. Watch the order, and remember that both terms in the bracket change sign.

questions.question: Priya simplifies (6x − 3) − (−2x − 8) and writes 4x − 11. Her friend Noah says the answer should be 8x + 5. Which statement is correct?
options: 8x + 5, because subtracting −2x adds 2x and subtracting −8 adds 8.
4x − 11, because subtracting a negative term still takes that amount away.
8x − 11, because only the first term inside the bracket changes its sign.
4x + 5, because the constant flips its sign but the x-term keeps its sign.
questions.explain: Add the opposite of every term of (−2x − 8): the opposite of −2x is +2x and the opposite of −8 is +8, so 6x − 3 + 2x + 8 = 8x + 5. Subtracting a negative is the same as adding it, which is exactly where 4x − 11 goes wrong.

questions.question: A community garden in Coquitlam has a rectangular plot with an area of (8x² + 3x + 12) square metres. A shed with an area of (2x² − 4x + 5) square metres and a pond with an area of (x² + 6x − 1) square metres are built on the plot. Which polynomial gives the area that is left for planting?
questions.explain: First add the shed and pond areas: 3x² + 2x + 4. Then subtract every term of that from the plot: 8x² + 3x + 12 − 3x² − 2x − 4 = 5x² + x + 8. If you subtract one building at a time instead, remember that taking away −4x adds 4x.

questions.question: Jasmine sells handmade bracelets at a Kamloops market. Selling n bracelets brings in (4n² + 30n) dollars. Her materials cost (n² − 5n + 20) dollars and the booth rental costs (3n + 10) dollars. Profit is the money brought in minus all costs. Which polynomial gives her profit, in dollars?
questions.explain: Add both costs first: (n² − 5n + 20) + (3n + 10) = n² − 2n + 30. Then subtract every term of that total: 4n² + 30n − n² + 2n − 30 = 3n² + 32n − 30. The trap is subtracting only the n² and leaving −2n + 30 with their signs unchanged.

questions.question: Ahmed says that (x² + 4x − 9) − (x² − 4x + 9) equals 0 because 'both brackets have the same three terms'. What is the correct result, and why?
options: 0, because after the x² is subtracted, the rest of the bracket is added as written.
8x, because the −9 and the +9 are the same size, so they cancel each other.
−18, because subtracting −4x takes 4x away, so only the constants are left.
8x − 18, because the opposite of −4x is +4x and the opposite of +9 is −9.
questions.explain: Add the opposite of every term in the second bracket: x² + 4x − 9 − x² + 4x − 9 = 8x − 18. Only the x² terms cancel; subtracting −4x adds 4x, and subtracting +9 takes away another 9.
